idea.title: Competitor price tracker — I check 6 sites manually every week, need automation

plan.tagline: Automates invoice tracking and reminders for freelancers and small businesses
plan.problem: Manual invoice tracking and follow-ups are time-consuming and prone to errors
plan.solution: InvoiceChase allows users to add invoices, list pending payments, generate reports, and receive alerts for overdue payments, all from a simple command-line interface
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide, especially those with limited accounting staff
mvp_features: Add invoices with client details and due dates
List pending payments with sorting and filtering options
Generate reports on invoice status and client balances
Receive alerts for overdue payments via email or in-app notifications
Support for --demo mode with sample data for offline testing

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: Design sqlite schema and implement add and list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Implement report generation and notification features

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Implement --demo mode, --help, and edge case handling

plan.demo_script: Runs a simulated invoice tracking scenario with sample clients and payments, demonstrating add, list, report, and alert features
plan.phuket_angle: Useful for Phuket-based tourism businesses to track invoices from clients worldwide, with support for multiple currencies and languages
